lead: Moving out or upgrading? BRS removes your office furniture and works with resellers and distributors to return value for what you no longer need.
card_blurb: Careful removal of used office furniture, prepared for resale through our reseller and distributor contacts.
meta_description: Removal of used office furniture, carefully dismantled and packaged for resale through resellers and distributors, since 1987.
overview: When you move out of an office or upgrade the one you have, the old furniture has to go somewhere. BRS removes it and works with resellers and furniture distributors to get you the best value for your used pieces.
Whatever your office layout, our team takes the furniture apart carefully and packages it neatly, ready for resale. BRS has been removing office furniture since 1987.

benefits.title: Value from used furniture
benefits.text: We work with resellers and distributors to recover value from furniture you no longer need.

benefits.title: Careful dismantling
benefits.text: Furniture is taken apart with care and packaged so it is ready for resale.

benefits.title: Fits your move plan
benefits.text: Removal can be coordinated with your relocation or decommissioning project.

included: Careful disassembly of workstations and other pieces
Work with resellers and furniture distributors

process.title: Review the furniture
process.text: We review what is leaving your space and how it is set up.

process.title: Dismantle and package
process.text: Our team takes the furniture apart and packages it for resale.

process.title: Remove and resell
process.text: We remove the furniture and work with resellers and distributors to place it.

who_for: Companies moving out of an office

faq.q: What happens to furniture BRS removes?
faq.a: We work with resellers and furniture distributors to get the best value for your used furniture.

faq.q: Can you handle any office set-up?
faq.a: Yes. Whatever your layout, we take furniture apart and package it for resale.

faq.q: Is liquidation part of a larger move?
faq.a: It can be. BRS also provides relocation, decommissioning and new furniture installation, so these can be coordinated.
